design_scope: Existing T01–T70, Levels1–100 and launch event families; no new feature family or post-launch release gate.

root_selected_forward_choices.survivor_cargo: Player and actually unlocked living survivors carry unlimited logical mixed raw, processed and ordinary-cash quantities; physical stacks aggregate; useful jobs and purchase budgets remain bounded.
root_selected_forward_choices.baseline_competence: Every unlocked living survivor has baseline competence for every ordinary reachable job, including gathering, assigned hunting, hauling, counter stocking, all-cash pickup, deposit, authorized plot purchases and paid repair/rebuild. Equipment/reachability is real; upgrades improve throughput, never unlock basic intelligence.
root_selected_forward_choices.pet_team: Three active living field pets initially; all seven species remain permanently unlocked once acquired. Live instances can die and require ordinary-resource replacement. Earned levels/XP/skills/unlocks/paid entitlements persist; replacement creates a new instance without cloned estate cargo. Free safe-camp selection cannot revive, heal or reset cooldowns.
root_selected_forward_choices.pet_attacks: Every species has a real usable species-specific attack in applicable play. Regional combat may be inapplicable with an honest useful safe assignment.
root_selected_forward_choices.normal_failure: Player down preserves owned inventory/currency/account progress and returns at full current health with controls/camera to a currently valid safe recovery anchor. A destroyed camp under siege is not a valid anchor; retain the initial safe arrival fallback. Pets and survivors can die permanently as live instances, and equipment can be destroyed; ordinary paid replacement/reconstruction is required.
root_selected_forward_choices.background: Gameplay simulation pauses; exact valid resume; no absence punishment or fabricated offline earnings. Active-play offscreen jobs conserve state.
root_selected_forward_choices.weapons: Two simple contextual autoattack families, axe initially and authored player spear; no action bar or ammunition wallet.
root_selected_forward_choices.post100: Celebration and continuation of existing loops and launch events; additional Level 100 activity families remain outside 1.0.
root_selected_forward_choices.currency: Ordinary money / Cash and one primary premium_gems / Gems family; migrate any previously selected premium-wallet identifier without deleting or duplicating value; no launch event token.
root_selected_forward_choices.hunting: Assigned survivor hunting and initiated attacks are allowed under U3. Retain hostile-wolf meat and selected Tundra Stag prey. Friendly companions are never hunt targets or meat sources; enemies can still attack them. Boar and other optional prey art remain reserve.
root_selected_forward_choices.repair_policy: Damaged owned structures use material/tier/missing-HP repair plots. Repair payments buy a fixed actual HP budget; new damage is not free. Destroyed fences/gates reconstruct their purchased tier. Destroyed equipment and furnace return at level1 after paid repurchase, and their upgrades must be earned again. Unconsumed escrow returns; already consumed repair work is not refunded while retaining healed HP.
root_selected_forward_choices.optional_pet_path: Pet rescue/availability objectives are optional and accessible from the main route. Every required campaign outcome is completable with no pet deployed; player/worker defense remains valid. Owned deployed pets add real useful attacks and work, not mandatory competence gates.
root_selected_forward_choices.counter: Bulk self-service for the full eligible processed catalogue. Player/unlocked living survivors stock requested products and collect/deposit all ordinary cash. Customers take a whole reserved basket and leave exact physical cash in a separate stack zone at one atomic contact commit. No cashier, register or spawned attendant role.
root_selected_forward_choices.quotes: Authored progression band, actual reachable catalogue, target type/tier and stable seed/offer ordinal determine new types/quantities. Prove full raw/recipe/producer/bill/tool/route quantities before admission. Freeze accepted terms and partial contributions across progression, cancellation and reload; use explicit paid-generation rebinding after counter replacement, never a price reroll. If a bound revisioned world authority proves an unpaid basket unobtainable after counting its actual usable stock and own escrow, retire that identity without income, preserve all terms/history and admit only the next ordinal. A valid, fully reserved or settled basket cannot use this transition.
root_selected_forward_choices.furnace_blackout: Furnace0HP pauses new arrivals, automated production and ordinary non-recovery jobs in its camp. Preserve owned stock/cash in live custody or typed salvage; permit manual gathering, recovery hunting, salvage/cash pickup, combat, authorized purchases and repair/rebuild. Repurchase furnace level1 using a reachable raw-only bill; re-earn upgrades.
root_selected_forward_choices.targeting: U3: a valid survivor attack attempt provokes that enemy. While the player OR a living deployed eligible defending pet is near, prefer valid defender/camp targets over unprovoked survivors. When BOTH are far, all characters and destructible camp equipment are eligible. Ranking is not collateral immunity or permanent camp sanctuary. Do not directly select an unprovoked survivor as a fallback while either valid defender remains nearby; actual contact may still cause collateral damage.

decisions_vs_evidence.design_choices: Meaningful outcomes, material functions, currency separation, protection/return rules and region identities can be selected now.
decisions_vs_evidence.measured_parameters: Exact costs, recipe yields, enemy damage, warning timing, throughput and overall pacing need real measurement; do not fabricate a balancing score.
decisions_vs_evidence.runtime_evidence: Requires actual candidate gameplay, save/restore, motion, source/render comparisons, audio and device tests.
not_closed_by_prose: T35/T36 exact SKU/perk/price records and runtime benefit evidence; money/Cash and premium_gems/Gems identities are selected.
decisions_vs_evidence.acceptance_policy: Reference dimensions≥9.9, stronger exact 10 visual/style gates, complete mandatory evidence; no score averaging.

gap_action_rows.title: Make death, destruction and blackout recoverable consequences
gap_action_rows.gap: The latest user rules supersede the prior free-care/immortal-companion/permanent-sanctuary selection; source gameplay does not yet demonstrate the new lifecycle.

Damaged owned structures use material/tier/missing-HP repair plots. Repair payments buy a fixed actual HP budget; new damage is not free. Destroyed fences/gates reconstruct their purchased tier. Destroyed equipment and furnace return at level1 after paid repurchase, and their upgrades must be earned again. Unconsumed escrow returns; already consumed repair work is not refunded while retaining healed HP. Furnace0HP pauses new arrivals, automated production and ordinary non-recovery jobs in its camp. Preserve owned stock/cash in live custody or typed salvage; permit manual gathering, recovery hunting, salvage/cash pickup, combat, authorized purchases and repair/rebuild. Repurchase furnace level1 using a reachable raw-only bill; re-earn upgrades.
gap_action_rows.action: Implement live-instance tombstones and ordinary replacement, structure HP/generations and paid repair/rebuild, U3 targeting, typed estate/ruin salvage, valid player anchors, and raw-only furnace recovery before depending on the penalties in later regions.

Destroyed equipment returns level1; boundary retains purchased tier
Finite siege defeat/retreat and scheduled-raid reconstruction pause without victory/reward farming

Actual game warning/contact/HP/death/ruin/recovery presentation and measured free-player recovery time
